eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: All India (Central scheme applicable across Delhi NCT, Haryana, UP, Punjab, and all states/UTs subject to scheme criteria).
eligibility_criteria.age_range: As per scheme rules / age eligibility criteria
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Per official department notification / income slab criteria
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: As specified in official scheme notification
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Applicants not meeting statutory residency/income/category rules or claiming overlapping benefit

benefit.summary_hi: विशेष पिछड़ी जनजातियों (PVTG) व 63,000+ आदिवासी गांवों में पक्का आवास, सड़क, स्वास्थ्य, बिजली व वन धन रोजगार संतृप्ति।
benefit.summary_en: 100% saturation of pucca homes (₹2.39L), clean water, mobile medical units, Van Dhan centres & roads across PVTG & 63,000+ tribal villages.

application_steps.offline: Submit verified documents at nearest CSC Common Service Centre / myScheme (myscheme.gov.in) / UMANG / JanSamarth
application_steps.facilitation_center: CSC Common Service Centre / myScheme (myscheme.gov.in) / UMANG / JanSamarth

anti_dalal.official_fee: ₹0 (Official government portal application is free unless statutory challan is notified)
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: CSC केंद्र पर केवल सामान्य सेवा शुल्क व रसीद लागू; सरकारी पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन आवेदन निःशुल्क
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Official portal online application is free; CSC operator assistance carries only a nominal statutory fee
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
